info.title: Portal Research Compare API
info.description: P20 named same-origin Compare reader. It consumes Portal-persisted Research facts only. It never exposes raw relations/cursors/artifact paths, starts QuantBT, changes a selection, publishes, approves or executes a command. Correlation is server-derived only from sealed exact-timestamp raw returns and is explicitly labelled PORTAL_DERIVED.

get.summary: Read bounded comparisons inside one Alpha
get.description: mode=attempts returns a claim-first ladder; mode=markets returns bounded small multiples only; mode=pair requires exactly two opaque same-Alpha run IDs. A mismatched key returns state REFUSED and pair:null, so no pair metric/chart exists for a consumer to render. Browser code must never compute a correlation, fill a missing timestamp, treat a rank as a promotion, or use a direct-source relation/cursor.

Runs.name: runs
Runs.description: Comma-separated two opaque Research run IDs; valid only with pair mode (or inferred pair mode).

Problem.description: Typed same-origin refusal. It never discloses a source relation, raw config/source payload, worker/lease identity, artifact path, cursor, credential, selection or governance control.

EnrichedAnalysisDistributions.title: ResearchAllTimeDistributions
EnrichedAnalysisDistributions.description: Additive precomputed OOS companion, including a partial leading month. Daily histogram is all-time, not a trade or per-bar histogram. Original seals remain immutable.

text.const: claims rank before numbers — inspection never selects, promotes, approves, or publishes a run.

MarketResult.description: D10 (2026-09-26): one card per market (the symbol · timeframe part of the ComparisonContractKey), represented by the latest run of an ACTIVE alpha version on it, else its latest run. A key without a market part is its own card.

caption.const: different contract keys — small multiples only; an overlay across keys would be a comparison lie.

message.const: these two runs do not share a ComparisonContractKey (symbol · timeframe · route · protocol) — a side-by-side would be a comparison lie, so the button refuses.

delta_definition.description: Every metric delta is right - left (B - A); a contract invariant (CG-P20-09).
